scope.claim_boundary: provisional naturalistic child-centered ages-3-to-5 calibration; never infant calibration

childlens_anchor.source: existing participant-distinct local calibration anchor only
permitted_aggregate_features: straight-line curvature by normalized image radius
not_identifiable: whether 140 degrees is horizontal or diagonal

camera.selection_rule: Retain the smallest model set not contradicted by aggregate straight-line curvature, radial coverage, and edge-motion evidence. If metadata and aggregate evidence cannot separate candidates, carry the set unchanged into later evaluation.

frozen_result.rationale: The 140-degree axis and lens calibration are absent; a 140-degree horizontal rectilinear assumption is unsupported. Existing permitted evidence establishes wide-angle edge curvature but does not identify coefficients.

forbidden: visible logos or readable product text

allowed_adaptive_repairs: camera implementation within the frozen uncertainty set
forbidden_repairs: direct target transform keyframing in scored clips
using a generative VLM as truth
stopping_rule: Stop with GO only if every frozen gate is verified across more than one room and instance. Otherwise repair the smallest failing component within the bounded routes; issue a precise NO_GO only after safe in-scope routes are exhausted or external access/license action is required.
